sources.title: Empero — Independent AI Research Lab
sources.snippet: New · Qwen3.8-9B / 4B / 2B — distilled Small models, trained in the open. We are an independent AI research lab in Germany, building language models efficient enough to run on hardware you own. Latest: a full-parameter distill of Qwen3.8-2.4T into 9B / 4B / 2B, and a GDN-aware 27B GGUF at 11.7 GiB. The open-weight Qwythos family has passed one million downloads on Hugging Face.
